veranderings.rede: This medicine is taken as tablets, and 'neem' is the standard verb for taking medicine; 'drink' is colloquial and suggests a liquid.

veranderings.blok: Hoe jy MIV nie kry nie
veranderings.voor: gewone dinge wat julle saam doen
veranderings.na: gewone dinge wat mense saam doen
veranderings.rede: 'julle' has no antecedent here (the text addresses 'jy' and talks about 'kinders' and 'n mens'), so the reader cannot tell who 'julle' is.

veranderings.blok: Wat jy doen as iemand bloei
veranderings.rede: In standard written Afrikaans 'wys' takes the indirect object without 'vir'; 'wys vir hom' is spoken usage.

veranderings.voor: 'n Virus in die bloed wat die liggaam se afweer swakker maak.
veranderings.na: 'n Virus wat in die bloed is en die liggaam se afweer swakker maak.
veranderings.rede: The relative clause 'wat ... maak' sits right after 'bloed', so it can be read as the blood weakening the body's defence; this ties it to the virus.
